post.caption:
You carry roughly 38 trillion bacteria against roughly 30 trillion human cells. They break down fibre your own enzymes cannot, manufacture vitamins you do not make yourself, and train your immune system early on what to leave alone. The gut-mood links are real but the causation is still being worked out. The genuinely startling case is already clinical: faecal transplants cure infections antibiotics cannot.
